central_idea_and_construction: A single airy abstract form suggesting a piece of fabric lifting in a breeze. Three broad smoothly tapering curved lobes gather into one flowing asymmetrical silhouette: a long lobe sweeps upward and right, a shorter plump lobe curls left, and a low gently hooked foot balances them. One generous crescent of white between the upper and left lobe is the identity. No literal kite, kite string, arrowhead, bird, leaf or letter. Flat one-color filled mark, each curve changes direction smoothly with no kinks, open negative space and blunt rather than pointed tips. Centered slightly above optical center, around 58% width and 60% height. No folded planes, diagonal cuts or engineering geometry.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Asymmetrical lift and one broad white crescent.
specific_risk: Too literal a wing or leaf would make the form generic.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
